findings.description: The change removes the `self.initial` attribute entirely, so code that reads `wait.initial` on a `wait_exponential_jitter` instance now raises AttributeError, even though the parameter is only meant to be deprecated.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any caller or subclass that reads `strategy.initial` after constructing `wait_exponential_jitter(initial=...)` or with the default. Mechanism: the old assignment `self.initial = initial` was deleted and nothing replaces it, so the attribute no longer exists. Impact: a deprecation should keep existing code working with a warning, but such code now fails at runtime with AttributeError.
